conform.notes: Source layer is เลขที่บ้าน (House Number) from Bangkok Metropolitan Administration's internal house-ID survey (HID/Survey_Basemap, layer 0) — a building-footprint layer linked to house-number records. This has the fullest structured address coverage of BMA's building layers: ~77% of records have BL_HOUSENUM, ~66% have BL_ROAD or BL_SOI filled (~58% have both), and BL_POSTCODE/BL_DISTRICT are filled in virtually every row. BL_ADDRESS (not mapped here) carries a full-text address if richer parsing is added later. A large share of unmatched rows carry a placeholder BLDG_ID of 0 with no house-number/address (digitized footprints not yet linked to a house record) and will simply be skipped by the pipeline for lacking number/street.
Same source service as the addresses layer; building footprint polygons for the whole city. See the addresses layer notes about server-side pagination slowness for a subset of records.
